inactive_projection_contract.selector_semantics: raw effective CharInfo selector; never remapped

source_evidence.load_guard: caller creates a resource only when returned name[0] != NUL
source_evidence.lookup_miss: negative/out-of-range/null Parts lookup returns empty string

fail_closed: any enabled selector outside the declared generation-typed active domain
any inactive selector not proven by the exact Nothing, false HairFront gate, or title lookup-empty contract
any Parts config, BFRES, packed-BNTX, Components, or resource-flag drift
any unresolved PartsIndex or enabled conditional model not represented here
legacy headwear selection without the original source CharInfo hair selector
treating legacy selector 34 or 57 as an LTD PartsIndex
